isValid.description: False once the AFK session has ended.

updatedAt.description: Last time the record was modified (ISO 8601).

endedAt.description: When the AFK session ended (ISO 8601). Null while the session is still active.

durationMs.description: Duration of the AFK session in milliseconds. For active sessions, measured against the time the response was generated.

limit.description: Limit echoed back from the request.

offset.description: Offset echoed back from the request.

reason.description: Optional reason shown alongside the AFK status. Max 200 characters.

endedAt.description: When the AFK session ended (ISO 8601). Null while the session is still active.

durationMs.description: Duration of the AFK session in milliseconds. For active sessions, measured against the time the response was generated.

displayName.description: Best available display name (nickname → globalName → username).

avatar.description: Discord avatar hash; clients build the CDN URL.

total.description: Total number of matching records in the guild.

limit.description: Limit echoed back from the request.

offset.description: Offset echoed back from the request.

discordAccessToken.description: Discord OAuth access token obtained by the frontend (scope: identify).

color.description: Hex color (#rrggbb), or null when the role has no color set.

iconUrls.description: Multi-size icon URLs, or null when no custom icon is set.

unicodeEmoji.description: Unicode emoji used as a fallback icon when no custom icon is set.

position.description: Higher position is rendered above lower in Discord.

hoist.description: Whether the role is displayed separately in the member list.

managed.description: True for integration-managed roles (e.g. booster role, bot roles).

avatarUrls.description: Multi-size URLs for the user's global avatar, or null when no avatar is set.

discordRoles.description: All Discord roles the member holds, sorted by position desc; @everyone excluded.

joinedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the user joined the guild.

premiumSince.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the user started server-boosting.

accountCreatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the Discord account was created (derived from the snowflake).

serverAvatarUrls.description: Multi-size URLs for the guild-specific avatar override, or null when the user uses their global avatar.

totalMembers.description: Active members in the guild (excluding members who have left).

joinedLast14d.description: Active members who joined within the last 14 days.

totalVoiceMinutes.description: All-time total of completed voice-channel time across the guild, in whole minutes (floored).

totalMessages.description: All-time total of user messages logged in the guild, including ones that were later deleted. Bot messages are not logged and therefore not counted.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when this snapshot was generated.

roleIds.description: Discord role IDs the member currently holds. Join client-side against /community/roles.

articleCount.description: Number of articles included in this digest.

articleIds.description: UUIDs of articles included in this digest.

updatedAt.description: When the digest was last updated (ISO 8601).

total.description: Total number of digests matching the query.

limit.description: Limit echoed back from the request.

offset.description: Offset echoed back from the request.

frequency.description: Frequency to generate. Omit to generate both daily and weekly.

skipped.description: Number of topic/frequency combinations skipped (no articles).

sourceId.description: External identifier from the source system.

topic.description: Topic / game this article relates to.

content.description: Full article body in Markdown format.

url.description: URL to the article on the source website.

fetchedAt.description: When the article was last synced from the source (ISO 8601).

contentType.description: AI-classified content type (e.g. news, guide, discussion).

limit.description: Limit echoed back from the request.

offset.description: Offset echoed back from the request.

updated.description: Number of existing articles updated with fresh content.

pagesScanned.description: Number of pages fetched from the source API during the sync.

type.description: Channel type (e.g. text, voice, category, announcement)

slug.description: URL-friendly slug derived from the mission name.

weekStart.description: The Tuesday this escalation week starts on (UTC).

fetchedAt.description: When this week was last synced from upstream (ISO 8601).

dailyCount.description: Number of daily-loot rows ingested for this week so far.

total.description: Total number of weeks matching the query.

offset.description: Offset echoed back from the request.

position.description: Zero-based slot for this loot item within the day. Pairs 1:1 with the mission at the same `position` on the parent week — i.e. running mission[position] today drops loot[position].

slug.description: URL-friendly slug derived from the loot-type name (weapon class, gear slot, or brand).
URL-friendly slug derived from the loot-type name (weapon class or gear slot).

gear.description: The gear slot sold as a prototype gear cache by the escalation vendor on this day, or null when upstream did not publish the value.

weapon.description: The weapon class sold as a prototype weapon cache by the escalation vendor on this day, or null when upstream did not publish the value.

day.description: The calendar day this targeted-loot rotation applies to (UTC).

fetchedAt.description: When this day was last synced from upstream (ISO 8601).

items.description: Targeted-loot items for this day, sorted by `position` ASC. item[position] drops from the parent week's mission at the same `position`.

prototypeCaches.description: Prototype caches sold by the escalation vendor on this day — one gear slot and one weapon class, independent of the mission/loot pairing on `items`. Either side is null when upstream did not publish that value.

weekStart.description: The Tuesday this escalation week starts on (UTC).

fetchedAt.description: When this week was last synced from upstream (ISO 8601).

missions.description: Five missions active during this week, sorted by `position` ASC. mission[position] is paired 1:1 with the targeted-loot item at the same `position` on every daily of this week.

dailies.description: Daily-loot rows ingested for this week so far, ordered by day ascending.

day.description: The calendar day this targeted-loot rotation applies to (UTC).

weekStart.description: The Tuesday this day belongs to (UTC).

fetchedAt.description: When this day was last synced from upstream (ISO 8601).

itemCount.description: Number of targeted-loot items in this day.

prototypeCaches.description: Prototype caches sold by the escalation vendor on this day — one gear slot and one weapon class. Either side is null when upstream did not publish that value.

total.description: Total number of dailies matching the query.

limit.description: Limit echoed back from the request.

offset.description: Offset echoed back from the request.

weekStart.description: The Tuesday this escalation week starts on (UTC).

fetchedAt.description: When this week was last synced from upstream (ISO 8601).

missions.description: Five missions active during this week, sorted by `position` ASC. mission[position] is paired 1:1 with the targeted-loot item at the same `position` on every daily of this week.

day.description: The calendar day this targeted-loot rotation applies to (UTC).

fetchedAt.description: When this day was last synced from upstream (ISO 8601).

items.description: Targeted-loot items for this day, sorted by `position` ASC. item[position] drops from `week.missions[position]`.

prototypeCaches.description: Prototype caches sold by the escalation vendor on this day — one gear slot and one weapon class, independent of the mission/loot pairing on `items`. Either side is null when upstream did not publish that value.

week.description: Summary of the week this day belongs to.

force.description: When true, deletes today’s claim row(s) before re-dispatching so the post goes out again. Old Discord messages are not edited or deleted — expect duplicates in the channel.

guildId.description: Optional Discord guild snowflake to scope the dispatch to a single guild. Omit to operate on every enabled guild (matches the cron).

channelId.description: The configured target channel snowflake. Null when the guild was not enabled.

status.description: Outcome of the dispatch attempt. `queued` = claim acquired and post emitted (actual send is async); `skipped-already-posted` = a claim row already existed for today; `skipped-not-enabled` = a `guildId` was supplied but is not in the enabled-target list.

forceCleared.description: True when this guild’s claim row was force-cleared on this run before re-claiming.

weeksProcessed.description: Number of upstream weeks scanned during this run.

daysIngested.description: Number of upstream daily-loot rows seen across all weeks.

newDaysIngested.description: Number of daily-loot rows newly inserted on this run.

prototypeCachesBackfilled.description: Number of prototype-cache rows attached to *already-existing* daily-loot rows on this run. Counts the backfill of legacy days that were ingested before caches existed; excludes caches saved as part of brand-new daily rows.

latestDay.description: The most recent upstream day seen, in YYYY-MM-DD form. Null when nothing was seen.

todayDailyIngested.description: Whether today’s daily-loot row is now in the database. When false, no dispatch was attempted because there is nothing to post.

forceClearedRows.description: Number of (guild, today) claim rows that were deleted as part of `force=true`. Always 0 when `force` was false.

dispatched.description: Per-guild dispatch outcomes. Empty when today’s daily was not yet ingested or no guilds had the feature enabled.

level.description: Numeric index of the next configured level.

xpRequired.description: Total XP the user must accumulate to reach this level.

label.description: Optional label configured for this level.

level.description: The level the user has currently reached.

levelLabel.description: Label configured for the current level, if any.

xp.description: Total XP earned by the user in this guild.

nextLevel.description: Next configured level, or null when the user is already at the highest configured level.

xpToNextLevel.description: XP remaining until the next level, or null when there is no next level.

progress.description: Progress within the current level band, in the inclusive range [0, 1].

rank.description: 1-indexed rank within the guild leaderboard sort.

displayName.description: Best available display name (nickname → globalName → username).

avatar.description: Discord avatar hash; clients build the CDN URL.

total.description: Total number of leveled users in the guild.

limit.description: Limit echoed back from the request.

offset.description: Offset echoed back from the request.

me.description: Caller’s own leaderboard entry; null when the caller has not earned XP in this guild.
